name: Inden (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Inden (a church on blue beneath a white chief).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Cologne of 6 May 1974 the municipality of Inden was granted the right to bear arms and a flag.

features.role: Inden arms — church on blue beneath white chief
